title: Pathwarden finding action: result (pathwarden.action-result.v1)
description: What a finding action program writes to the file named in PATHWARDEN_ACTION_RESULT when PATHWARDEN_ACTION_REQUEST is run: whether it worked, a message, links and records. docs/actions.md explains each field. A result that passes this schema is kept as it is; Pathwarden cuts a text that is too long and leaves out a link or record it can't keep, each with a problem `pathwarden action check` names. No text is ever read as HTML. Fields Pathwarden doesn't know are ignored, so the schema allows them.

schema.$comment: Missing: noted as a problem. Another value: the run failed.

ok.description: Whether the action worked. Missing or not true or false: the run failed. A run counts as worked only when ok is true and the program exited 0.

message.description: What happened, in plain words, at most 2,000 characters. It may hold line breaks. Empty: "Done." when it worked.

links.description: At most 5 links the result card offers.

records.description: At most 5 things the action created or looks after, saved on the finding. Each id must be unique in the list.
records.$comment: Each record's id must be unique in the list; a second one is left out.

url.description: An https:// address with a host and without a user name or password, spaces or control characters, at most 2,048 characters.

label.description: The link's text, at most 80 characters.

id.description: The record's ID in the other system, at most 200 characters. A follow-up returns the same id to update the record. Missing, empty or too long: the record is left out.

kind.description: What it is, e.g. ticket or request.

label.description: A name to show when it has no number.

number.description: The number people know it by, e.g. RITM10816190. Shown on the chip.

url.description: Where to open it. Not https://: left out, the record kept.

status.description: Its status in the other system, e.g. Open. Shown on the chip.

open.description: True while it is open in the other system: an action with once stays hidden, and a fixed finding's chip says it is still open. Default false.

fields.description: At most 20 named values to show with it. Names at most 60 characters; values text (numbers and true or false are kept as text), at most 200 characters.
